repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q002: The two physical failure sites are now concrete and mapped by subsystem function rather than an unrelated brain metaphor.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q003: Alternatives now compare actual software/bus/radio roles, with item-bound ROS primary evidence.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q005: All four alternatives use the same titanium/silicone properties and plausible neighboring source categories.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q006: Alternatives consistently vary source weight, cost or star-count entries; qualitative scope retained.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q008: The actuator-versus-complete-installation boundary, seal friction and leakage are meaningful competing system assumptions.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q009: All alternatives name credible pneumatic phenomena; the stem explicitly asks which pair the source highlights.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q011: Brushless switching, continuous rings and induction-fed rotor are realistic competing constructions.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q014: Citation locator now covers all four bullets, including the previously omitted electronic-commutation premise. The combined construction/cooling/switching answer is complete.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q015: The alternatives now concern Hall/encoder, back-EMF startup and electrical measurements; TI primary evidence stays item-bound.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q017: Fixed-frequency drive, speed-only VFD and closed-loop servo are distinct plausible architectures; modern manufacturer evidence retained.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q018: Revised choices distinguish contact geometry and closure/wrapping behavior in the two source mechanisms.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q020: Alternatives distinguish magnetic response from conductivity, mass and gap/contact assumptions, rather than implausible total absence of magnetic physics.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q021: Independent command counts are now explicitly declared, separating finger count, action dimension and task capability.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q023: Classification alternatives now compare physical quantity, mounting location, net wrench/spatial map and signal format.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q028: Concrete memory capacities and verified MCU latency make workload allocation determinate without equating memory or clock rate to a timing guarantee.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q032: Choices compare precision/sparsity mismatch, isolated kernel timing, throughput and end-to-end latency; vendor evidence retained.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q033: The revised cloud comparison includes complete 8–20 ms path bounds and outages. The local 8 ms bound is the only demonstrated deadline result.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q040: The 83.25-minute alternative is correctly explained as compute-only 20 W, omitting motor and sensor load; all alternative arithmetic independently reproduced.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q042: The interface examples are expressly source-specific, and alternatives interchange actual devices within the named protocol lists.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q043: Bosch CAN FD primary evidence is directly attached; faster data phase is qualified by implementation constraints.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q044: NXP mode definitions are directly attached; source common-rate range is not an exhaustive family maximum.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q047: Official ROS primary evidence is directly attached and distinguishes middleware from transport, without treating DDS as a latency guarantee.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q049: Measured angle, issued PWM and designed reward are correctly separated with parallel role confusions.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q050: The two trials now demonstrate identical positions with different velocity/contact state; deterministic rescaling or identical target cannot recover the missing information.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q051: Item-bound motor manufacturer evidence supports the qualified waveform/load/voltage relation; no universal duty-to-speed ratio is claimed.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q053: The inclusive force-band AND target-region reward rule is fully supplied; all alternatives test a different rule or units error.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q054: The corrected 18 ms alternative now genuinely equals period plus inference, and its rationale accurately names that addition error.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q056: Formula metadata is restricted to degree-to-radian conversion of a bound, without importing a hidden probability distribution.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q059: The actual band-limited signal and sampling rule are explicit; reconstruction threshold, policy rate and end-to-end deadlines remain distinct.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q061: All four alternatives are parallel mappings of the actual fusion motivations.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q065: Both promised inverse-variance expressions now appear before the answer. Independently computed mean 2.6 m and variance 0.8 m²; all alternatives have coherent arithmetic origins.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q066: A fixed shared bias and independent zero-mean noises are explicitly supplied. Bias persists, random variance halves, and variance is not conflated with mean squared error.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q068: All choices reorder genuine source pipeline stages; the five-step explanation follows the displayed sequence.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q069: Choices distinguish acquisition clocks, arrival timing, static extrinsics and nominal rate; only a justified time alignment/motion model resolves the stated offset.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q071: Reach and Jacobian-rank premises are explicit and separate, allowing an attainable singular pose without claiming arbitrary six-DOF reach.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q072: A bounded controlled comparison now distinguishes an explicit environmental friction change from separately verified calibration, timing and actuator limits; the item remains honestly easy.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q076: Unknown contact stiffness/transmission friction makes the calibrated wrench measurement the direct feedback route; alternatives are realistic but unsupported proxies.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q077: Fresh coupled design independently yields aluminium torque 0.7 N·m versus steel 1.1 N·m, with the stated 0.8 limit, source cost, electronic commutation and one-command tool constraints. All alternatives fail a distinct condition.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q078: Fresh candidate selection independently includes 22.2 Wh usable energy, every load, 1 ms framed command, 12.288 Mbps camera payload and complete serial path. A alone passes; B fails energy, C timing and D bandwidth.
repairResolutions.W11-L51-Q079: Fresh failure-aware pipeline uses valid LiDAR/IMU with acquisition-time correction, uncertain slipping odometry, near-range ultrasound and independently validated loop closure; no nonexistent GNSS/vision or exact-pose guarantee is invented.
